comment: Identity of this project. `slug` is the tenant id it serves - it must match clients.tenant_id, because that is what every WHERE tenant_id filter and RLS policy keys on. The DIRECTORY name is only a label. `vertical` must be one of the builder's AllowedVerticals (fnb, salon, laundry, klinik, gym, bimbel, bengkel, beauty, travel, property, katering, photo, sports). `contact` is the owner contact quoted in refusal and quota replies.
